name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)

eligibility.other_conditions: Houseless families or households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas as per SECC 2011 or Awaas+ list. Must not own a pucca house.

benefits: Direct financial grant of Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult states for construction of a disaster-resilient pucca house with toilet and clean cooking gas.
documents_required: Job Card / MGNREGA Number (for 90 days unskilled labor allowance)
application_process: Beneficiary identified via Gram Sabha verification from Awaas+ portal list.
Geo-tagging of existing site before and during stage-wise construction.
DBT installments credited directly across plinth, lintel, and roof completion stages.
statutory_citation: Ministry of Rural Development Framework for Implementation No. J-11060/01/2016-RH
